name: prompt-library
description: 提示词管理、分类与云同步桌面工具
author: 提示词助手

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.package:win: set ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/&& set ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/&& npm run clean:release && npm run build && node scripts/write-update-source.cjs && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never && node scripts/clean-release.cjs --keep
scripts.package:installer: set ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/&& set ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/&& npm run clean:release && npm run build && node scripts/write-update-source.cjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never && node scripts/clean-release.cjs --keep
scripts.package:unpacked: set ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/&& set ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/&& npm run clean:release && npm run build && node scripts/write-update-source.cjs && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never && node scripts/clean-release.cjs --keep
scripts.package:all: set ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/&& set ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/&& npm run clean:release && npm run build && node scripts/write-update-source.cjs && electron-builder --win portable nsis dir --x64 --publish never && node scripts/clean-release.cjs --keep
scripts.release:publish: npm run package:all && npm run publish:update
